hero.rangeSub: Five lines from one factory. The plain yellow pack Malaysia cooks at home, and the seasoned range that travels.
hero.lede: Since 1975, one factory in Kuala Lumpur has made the noodle Malaysians reach for without thinking. The yellow pack that sits in the cupboard, the one your mother bought, still made to the recipe the family started with. Today it feeds more than 20 markets and has not changed a thing.

back.heading: COOKING INSTRUCTIONS

steps.en: Boil 400ml of water in a pot.
Add the noodle cake, cook 3 minutes.
Drain, season to taste, serve hot.

back.ingredients: Wheat flour, palm oil, salt, mineral salts.

pack._note: Drives the real-time 3D packaging artwork. Text, colours and figures are all live fields.

story.lede: Before the brand, there was the factory. Vit Makanan (K.L.) Sdn. Bhd. has made noodles in Kuala Lumpur since 1975, halal certified since 1980, and quietly feeds a country that knows the yellow pack by sight.

tiles.body: The family starts making noodles in Kuala Lumpur. The phoenix goes on the first wrapper.
Halal certified by JAKIM. 46 years unbroken, with preferential access across the Gulf.
Of revenue is the Malaysian plain noodle base. The home market is served first, always.
Of export experience across dozens of markets.
A year on the world circuit. Dubai first, then the United States, Bangkok and the UK.

story.footNote: Dates as published by Vit's. Final verification before anything goes to print or page.

trade.cartonCaption: The real carton, as it ships. OEM, private label and bulk, from Kuala Lumpur to 20+ markets.

checks.title: Formats
checks.body: Pillow packs, mini packs, zip packs, air-dried kraft, cup on request. Retail 4-packs to 700g economy family packs.

checks.title: Shelf life
checks.body: Fried and air-dried lines with export-grade shelf life, stated per SKU on the specification sheet.

checks.title: Certifications
checks.body: FSSC 22000, HACCP, GMP, ISO 22000, and JAKIM halal held since 1980.

checks.title: Customisation
checks.body: Your recipe or ours. Seasoning development, your label, your language, your compliance.

trade.lede: Buyers open with 1 question: can you create a taste like Buldak, like Indomie. The answer is the factory itself. 51 years of noodle mastery, a seasoning kitchen that speaks curry, tom yam, rendang and beyond, and a line that runs your recipe under your label.

items.body: 5 cakes, 350 grams, 1 decision. The pack that built the company and still anchors the Malaysian kitchen.
